title: The Locked Room Manuscript
setting: St. Jude University Special Collections Vault
incident: A 14th-century illuminated manuscript, the 'Codex Aureus', vanished from the university vault during a 17-minute security system outage between 11:15 PM and 11:32 PM. The climate-controlled vault has biometric and keycard locks with no forced entry.
centralQuestions: How was the vault opened without triggering the physical fail-safe bolts?
Did the keycard swipe belong to the person who actually entered?
What role did the emergency ventilation maintenance request play?
Who had the specialist knowledge to extract the codex without causing humidity alarms?

timeline.event: Visiting Professor Dr. Alistair Vance checks out research notes adjacent to the vault.
Archivist Clara Bell conducts final preservation inspection and locks vault door.
A maintenance request for HVAC calibration is logged from an internal terminal.
Security camera system enters diagnostic reboot lasting 17 minutes.
Vault electronic door sensor registers an opening using Senior Technician Card #12.
Camera system comes back online. Vault hallway is empty.
Graduate researcher Liam Chen reports the manuscript display box is empty.

suspects.name: Clara Bell
suspects.motive: Facing professional audit over missing rare book budget funds.
suspects.statement: She claims she left the building at 11:05 PM and drove straight home.
relevant_evidence: She possesses master vault emergency codes.
Toll booth photo shows her car passing at 11:40 PM.
suspicious_evidence: Her sign-out time was manually handwritten rather than scanned.
suspects.uncertainty: Sign-out discrepancy leaves an 8-minute gap in her departure.
open_questions: Did she leave at 11:05 PM or remain inside?

suspects.name: Derek Morales
suspects.motive: Heavy off-track gambling losses; threatened by collectors.
suspects.statement: He says his Card #12 was left on his workshop pegboard during his shift.
relevant_evidence: Card #12 was used to open vault at 11:22 PM.
HVAC reboot initiated from his assigned terminal.
supporting_evidence: Two colleagues state Derek was in the staff cafeteria playing cards at 11:20 PM.
suspicious_evidence: His card opened the vault during the blackout.
suspects.uncertainty: Card usage does not prove physical presence; workshop door was unlocked.
open_questions: Who had physical access to the technician workshop pegboard?

suspects.name: Dr. Alistair Vance
suspects.motive: Obsessed with manuscript provenance; previously bid on illicit private antiquities.
suspects.statement: He says he was working in the reading room until security told him to leave at 11:00 PM.
relevant_evidence: Leather gloves found in his briefcase matching vault velvet case texture.
supporting_evidence: Librarian saw him packing papers in reading room at 11:00 PM.
suspicious_evidence: His briefcase contained high-grade archival handling tweezers.
suspects.uncertainty: Archival tools are normal equipment for a paleography professor.
open_questions: Where was he between 11:00 PM and 11:45 PM?

suspects.name: Liam Chen
suspects.motive: Denied doctoral fellowship extension; desperate for publishing leverage.
suspects.statement: He says he arrived at 11:45 PM to complete late-night scans and found the vault breached.
relevant_evidence: Possessed digital camera with macro zoom.
supporting_evidence: Turnstile log records his arrival at 11:43 PM.
suspicious_evidence: Turnstile badge swipe could be faked or tailgated.
suspects.uncertainty: Turnstile time is 11 minutes after the camera reboot ended.
open_questions: Did he have an accomplice inside?

suspects.name: Elena Rostova
suspects.motive: Disputed ownership claim over historical European religious documents.
suspects.statement: She claims she was in the restoration chemical lab on floor 3 all evening.
relevant_evidence: Chemical solvent traces matching vault seal adhesive found on her apron.
supporting_evidence: Fume hood exhaust logs confirm chemical lab activity.
suspicious_evidence: Adhesive solvent is identical to the compound used to detach the manuscript casing.
suspects.uncertainty: Solvents are common across all university restoration projects.
open_questions: Was the vault casing chemically dissolved or mechanically unlocked?

witnesses.name: Marcus Todd
witnesses.statement: The camera reboot was scheduled for maintenance, but happened 2 hours early.
witnesses.limitations: Did not investigate the floor during reboot.

witnesses.name: Sarah Jenkins
witnesses.statement: Derek Morales was in the cafeteria around 11:20 PM talking about football.
supporting_information: Receipt for hot coffee at 11:18 PM.

evidence.title: Vault Access Log Buffer
evidence.description: Offline buffer records Card #12 swiped at 11:22 PM with valid PIN.
evidence.establishes: Vault was unlocked electronically at 11:22 PM.

evidence.title: HVAC Terminal Request
evidence.description: A scheduled maintenance command was triggered at 11:10 PM from Maintenance Desk Terminal 4.
evidence.establishes: Camera reboot was caused by HVAC diagnostic command.
evidence.reliability_notes: Terminal was left unlocked in common area.

evidence.title: Latex Glove Fragment
evidence.description: A torn blue nitrile glove tip found caught on the vault display latch.
evidence.establishes: Perpetrator wore disposable blue nitrile gloves.

evidence.title: Zurich Flight Booking
evidence.description: Flight itinerary found in Dr. Vance's coat pocket departing at 6:00 AM.
evidence.establishes: Dr. Vance planned immediate international travel.
evidence.does_not_establish: That the travel was flight from prosecution.

evidence.title: Adhesive Residue Swab
evidence.description: Chemical residue on vault frame matches specialized cellulose ester solvent.
evidence.establishes: Solvent was used near the display.

redHerrings: Derek's Card #12 was used, but cafeteria witnesses and coffee receipts establish he was playing cards during the swipe.
Dr. Vance's flight ticket appears like an escape, but he was scheduled to give a keynote lecture in Zurich.

hiddenSolution.explanation: Facing an imminent financial audit, Clara took Derek's unattended Card #12 from the technician pegboard, triggered the maintenance reboot from the shared terminal at 11:10 PM, manually faked her 11:05 PM sign-out, entered the vault at 11:22 PM, and concealed the manuscript in her car trunk before driving through the toll at 11:40 PM.
uncertainties: Whether someone helped her transport the manuscript
Exact location of the manuscript currently
hiddenSolution.alternativeExplanation: Elena Rostova utilized the solvent to breach the case while Derek's card was borrowed by a third party.

missingEvidence: Camera footage of the technician pegboard
rules: A ticket booking is not proof of flight.
Alibi timing must be matched to electronic log buffers.
